product_overview: Verdexis is an AI-powered multi-asset trading and digital banking platform that lets users manage portfolios, execute trades, and handle wallet operations in one unified interface. The app also provides market browsing, price alerts, KYC submission, staking, and account settings for a complete fintech experience.
core_goals: Create an account and access a personalized financial dashboard
Browse crypto and stock markets and inspect individual asset details
Execute buy and sell trades and review portfolio updates
Manage wallet balances through deposits, withdrawals, conversions, and transfers
Track transaction history, activity, alerts, goals, and staking progress
Submit KYC information and manage profile and security settings

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Users can register, log in, and enter the app through an authenticated session.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Choose to sign up or log in -> Enter email and password, and phone number when registering -> Submit the form -> See the dashboard after successful authentication
Navigate to / -> Choose to sign up -> Enter a password that is too short -> Submit the form -> See validation feedback
Navigate to / -> Choose to log in -> Enter incorrect credentials -> Submit the form -> See validation feedback

features.name: Dashboard Holdings & Performance
features.description: Authenticated users can review net worth, portfolio performance, holdings, wallet balances, and recent activity from a central dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View net worth and performance KPIs -> Review holdings allocation and wallet balances -> Switch the chart range -> See the portfolio chart and summary update
Navigate to /dashboard -> Review the holdings list -> Observe deduplicated crypto positions merged from trading and wallet balances -> Open recent trades and wallet activity summaries

features.name: Trading
features.description: Users can browse assets and place buy or sell trades that update their portfolio.
user_flows: Navigate to /trading -> Select an asset -> Choose buy or sell -> Enter the trade amount -> Submit the order -> See a trade confirmation and updated portfolio
Navigate to /trading -> Select an asset -> Choose buy or sell -> Enter an amount larger than the available balance -> Submit the order -> See validation feedback

features.name: Market Browser and Asset Detail
features.description: Users can explore live market listings and inspect chart-based asset detail pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /markets -> Browse the market list -> Search for an asset by name or symbol -> Open an asset from the list -> View its market information
Navigate to /asset/bitcoin -> Review the asset chart and price data -> Explore the detailed market view -> Return to the broader market browsing experience

features.name: Wallet Operations
features.description: Authenticated users can manage fiat and crypto balances through deposits, withdrawals, conversions, and transfers.
user_flows: Navigate to /wallet -> Generate a deposit address -> Copy or review the address -> Return to wallet balances

Navigate to /wallet -> Choose to withdraw funds -> Enter the withdrawal amount and destination details -> Review the processing fee -> Submit the request -> See the withdrawal recorded in wallet activity
Navigate to /wallet -> Choose to convert currency -> Select source and destination currencies -> Enter the amount -> Submit the conversion -> See updated balances
Navigate to /wallet -> Choose to transfer funds -> Enter another user as the recipient -> Enter the amount -> Submit the transfer -> See the transfer recorded in wallet history

features.name: Transaction and Trade Activity
features.description: Authenticated users can review their past trades and wallet transactions in a chronological activity view.
user_flows: Navigate to /activity -> Review the transaction and trade history -> Inspect amounts, symbols, and timestamps -> Use the history as a record of prior account actions

features.name: Price Alerts
features.description: Users can create and manage price alerts for selected assets.
user_flows: Navigate to /alerts -> Create a new alert by selecting a symbol and threshold -> Save the alert -> See it appear in the alerts list
Navigate to /alerts -> Toggle an existing alert on or off -> Observe the alert status change
Navigate to /alerts -> Delete an alert -> See it removed from the list

features.name: Savings and Investment Goals
features.description: Users can define and track financial goals.
user_flows: Navigate to /goals -> Create a new savings or investment goal -> Enter the goal details and target amount -> Save the goal -> See it added to the goals list
Navigate to /goals -> Review existing goals -> Update progress by contributing toward a goal -> Observe progress change

features.name: KYC Submission
features.description: Authenticated users can submit identity information and documents for verification.
user_flows: Navigate to /kyc -> Fill in personal information -> Upload an identity document -> Submit the KYC form -> See the submission status

features.name: Referral Program
features.description: Authenticated users can view their referral dashboard and share referral information.
user_flows: Navigate to /referral -> Review the referral dashboard -> Copy or share referral details -> See referral activity and rewards information

features.name: Paper Trading
features.description: Authenticated users can practice simulated trading without affecting real holdings.
user_flows: Navigate to /paper-trading -> Select an asset -> Enter a simulated buy or sell order -> Submit the order -> See the simulated portfolio update

features.name: DCA Scheduler
features.description: Authenticated users can schedule recurring buys and manage scheduled investment plans.
user_flows: Navigate to /dca -> Create a recurring buy schedule -> Choose the asset, amount, and cadence -> Save the schedule -> See it added to the schedule list
Navigate to /dca -> Open an existing schedule -> Pause or delete the schedule -> Observe the schedule status change

features.name: Portfolio Rebalancing
features.description: Authenticated users can adjust portfolio allocations through rebalancing tools.
user_flows: Navigate to /rebalance -> Review current portfolio allocation -> Choose a rebalance target -> Submit the rebalance plan -> See the allocation update

features.name: Tax-Loss Harvesting
features.description: Authenticated users can review tax-harvesting opportunities and act on them.
user_flows: Navigate to /tax -> Review tax-loss harvesting opportunities -> Select an eligible asset action -> Submit the harvesting action -> See the tax strategy reflected in the plan

features.name: Staking Management
features.description: Authenticated users can manage staking positions and track staking activity.
user_flows: Navigate to /staking -> Review available staking options and current positions -> Choose a staking action -> Confirm the staking change -> See the staking position update

features.name: Profile and Security Settings
features.description: Authenticated users can edit profile details, change their password, and manage security preferences.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Edit profile information -> Save the changes -> See the updated profile settings
Navigate to /settings -> Change the password -> Submit the update -> See confirmation that the password was changed
Navigate to /settings -> Toggle security preferences such as 2FA-related settings -> Save the changes -> See the updated security state

routes.description: Marketing home page with login/signup CTAs
User portfolio dashboard with holdings, wallet balances, performance metrics
Trading interface (admins blocked from placing trades)
Individual user admin view (fee proofs approve/reject)

features.name: User Signup & Login
features.description: Email+password authentication with optional phone, KYC banner, email verification flow
user_interactions: Click Login or Sign Up CTA on Home
Fill email, password (and phone on signup)
See validation errors or land on /dashboard

features.name: Dashboard Holdings & Performance
features.description: Combined holdings view (Holding table + non-fiat WalletBalance merged by symbol), donut chart, performance KPIs reflecting merged list
user_interactions: View net worth and KPI tiles
View Holdings list (one row per crypto symbol, deduped across trades and wallet balances)

features.name: Trading (Buy/Sell)
features.description: Place market trades against authoritative server-fetched price; admin accounts blocked

features.name: Wallet Operations (deposit/withdraw/convert/transfer)
features.description: Deposit address generation, withdrawal with inverse processing-fee schedule, currency convert, user-to-user transfer; bonus-locked & email-verified gates enforced
user_interactions: Submit withdrawal request and see processing fee

features.name: Fee Proof Upload & Admin Approval
features.description: User uploads withdrawal-fee or bonus-unlock fee payment proof; admin approves/rejects (bonus_unlock approval no longer auto-clears the lock)
user_interactions: Admin views pending proofs panel and approves/rejects

features.name: Price Alerts
features.description: Create, edit, delete price alerts that fire client-side via polling

features.name: KYC Submission
features.description: Upload KYC documents; status flips Verified badge when approved

features.name: DCA Scheduler
features.description: Schedule recurring buys; admin accounts blocked

features.name: Profile & Security Settings
features.description: Update profile (protected prefs keys stripped server-side), change password, manage 2FA

known_limitations.issue: Admin accounts cannot place trades or schedule DCA (returns 403 admin_no_trade)
known_limitations.impact: Admin test users will see banner and toast on Trading page; tests should use a non-admin user for trade flows

known_limitations.issue: Bonus-locked users blocked from withdraw/transfer/convert until manual admin clear
known_limitations.impact: Tests touching wallet flows must use a user without bonusLocked flag

known_limitations.issue: Pre-existing inline-style lint warnings in Dashboard.tsx
known_limitations.impact: Lint warnings only, do not block tests
